notes: Assigned original fields only. Identity verified from title and DOI in supplied canonical source. Study 3 main willingness outcome has an unadjusted God-versus-control effect b = 0.61, t(99) = 2.29, p = .024; mediator-adjusted direct effect b = 0.28, t(98) = 1.12, p = .267. Both are candidate tests of the described relationship; neither selected without a test-specific locator. Figure 4 explicitly labels coefficients unstandardized. The requested test statistic, if the unadjusted test is intended, is t = 2.29; if the adjusted test is intended, t = 1.12. No conversion made. The distinct perceived-danger outcome is b = −0.44, t(99) = −2.97, p = .004, not selected as willingness to take risks. Candidate model/sample N = 101: Method explicitly states 101 completed; p. 5 scenario-interaction model explicitly prints N = 101; p. 6 says analyses were collapsed across the three scenarios. No N derived from df, recruitment capacity, or group arithmetic. Common N retained only as candidate for parent field-scope review because test correspondence is unresolved. PDF p. 6 rendered and inspected. Replication and success fields are unassigned placeholders.
